description_en: Invokes a published Camera Agent to recognize food and beverages and detect new persons in scenes. Food recognition returns the locations and counts of targets. Person detection deduplicates against recorded portraits in the scene and returns at most one new person per request. The recognition capabilities are determined by the published configuration of the instance. Both JSON and Server-Sent Events (SSE) responses are supported. All bounding boxes use the pixel coordinates of the original image
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Camera Agent，支持食物饮品识别和场景新人检测。食物识别返回目标位置和数量；人物检测结合场景内已收录的人像去重，每次最多返回一名新人。识别能力由实例已发布配置决定，支持 JSON 和 SSE 返回，检测框均使用原图像素坐标
name: CameraChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The access key of the specified Camera instance. Provide the raw value without the Bearer prefix. This key is not an AccessKey secret and cannot replace an OpenAPI signature
parameters.help_zh: 所指定 Camera 实例的访问密钥，填写原始值，无需 Bearer 前缀。此密钥不是 AccessKey Secret，不能替代 OpenAPI 签名
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the published CameraStandard instance. This ID must correspond to the `X-QI-Agent-Api-Key` header. The recognition scene, model, and thresholds are derived from the published configuration of this instance
parameters.help_zh: 已发布的 CameraStandard 实例 ID，必须与 X-QI-Agent-Api-Key 对应；识别场景、模型和阈值来自该实例的已发布配置
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The optional session ID. If omitted, a session ID is generated. Reuse the original value for continuation and successful replay. For the format and retrieval method, refer to the supplementary instructions
parameters.help_zh: 可选会话 ID，省略时生成；续接和成功重放复用原值，格式与获取方式见补充说明
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

parameters.help_en: The request ID. A trusted POP ID is preferred. If no trusted POP ID is available, this header is required. The `requestId` field in the request body is not accepted. For the format and retry rules, refer to the supplementary instructions
parameters.help_zh: 请求 ID，可信 POP ID 优先；没有时本 Header 必填，不接受 Body.requestId。格式及重试见补充说明
parameters.name: x_qi_request_id

fields.help_en: A publicly accessible HTTPS URL or a complete Base64 image data URL. Signed URLs must remain valid during execution. Both the image and the request body are subject to size limits. Use a URL for large images
fields.help_zh: 公开可访问的 HTTPS URL 或完整 Base64 图片 Data URL。签名链接须在执行期间有效；图片和请求体分别受大小限制，大图优先使用 URL
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The HTTP JSON key is `image_url`. Required. Contains the `url` field for the image address
fields.help_zh: HTTP JSON 键名为 image_url；必填，包含图片地址字段 url
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: Required. Contains one `image_url` image. Do not place custom recognition prompts here
fields.help_zh: 必填，包含一张 image_url 图片，不将自定义识别提示词放在此处
fields.name: content

parameters.help_en: Required. Provide only one `role=user` message and one image. Multiple images, custom text, and videos are not supported, and you cannot invoke tools
parameters.help_zh: 必填，只提供一条 role=user 消息和一张图片。不支持多图、自定义文本、视频或工具调用
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: The HTTP JSON key is `scene_id`. Required for person recognition. The value must be non-empty, contain no leading or trailing whitespace, and be up to 50 characters in length. Reuse the same scene for person recognition. Omit this field for food recognition
parameters.help_zh: HTTP JSON 键名为 scene_id。人物识别必填，非空、无首尾空白，最长 50 个字符；同一人物场景复用，食物识别省略
parameters.name: scene_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return an SSE response. If set to `true`, an SSE response is returned. If set to `false` or omitted, a complete JSON detection result is returned. SSE transmits the final result and does not output token by token
parameters.help_zh: true 返回 SSE；false 或省略返回完整检测结果 JSON。SSE 传输最终结果，不是逐 Token 输出
parameters.name: stream

200.description_en: stream=true 返回 SSE，否则返回 JSON
200.description_zh: stream=true 返回 SSE，否则返回 JSON

schema.description_en: In JSON mode, a complete detection result object is returned. In SSE mode, the result JSON string in `delta.content` is read and parsed by event. For the protocol, fields, and complete examples, refer to the supplementary instructions for response parameters
schema.description_zh: JSON 模式返回完整检测结果对象，SSE 模式按事件读取并解析 delta.content 中的结果 JSON 字符串；协议、字段和完整示例见返回参数补充说明
schema.title_en: 原始 HTTP 响应体。stream（调试接口为 input.stream）设为 false 或省略时，Content-Type 为 application/json，响应体是完整检测结果 JSON 对象；stream=true 时，Content-Type 为 text/event-stream，按 SSE 事件读取，再解析 choices[0].delta.content 中的完整结果 JSON 字符串。下方“返回参数补充说明”列出两类结果的完整字段、JSON 示例及 SSE 示例。此处 string 表示原始响应体的传输类型，不表示 JSON 结果是字符串，也不表示返回二进制文件。
schema.title_zh: 原始 HTTP 响应体。stream（调试接口为 input.stream）设为 false 或省略时，Content-Type 为 application/json，响应体是完整检测结果 JSON 对象；stream=true 时，Content-Type 为 text/event-stream，按 SSE 事件读取，再解析 choices[0].delta.content 中的完整结果 JSON 字符串。下方“返回参数补充说明”列出两类结果的完整字段、JSON 示例及 SSE 示例。此处 string 表示原始响应体的传输类型，不表示 JSON 结果是字符串，也不表示返回二进制文件。

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The required single-image request object. The `messages` field is required. For person recognition, the `scene_id` field must also be provided. For examples, see the following sections
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 必填的单图请求对象，messages 必填；人物识别还须提供 scene_id，示例见下方
v1_body_parameters.name: body
